{{< include _load.qmd >}}

Every time the site loads, it checks `data/database.xlsx`. A Verified or Unverified record that fails a check is **hidden from every page** until the workbook is fixed, and is listed below.

```{ojs}
{
  const rowsBySheet = [
    ["Organisations", data.orgsAll.length],
    ["Opportunities", data.oppsAll.length],
    ["Places", data.placesAll.length],
    ["About", data.about.length]
  ];
  const statuses = ["Verified", "Unverified", "Excluded"];
  const other = [...data.statusCounts].filter(([k]) => !statuses.includes(k));
  const shownVerified = opps.filter(o => o.verified).length;
  return htl.html`<div class="tile-grid tile-grid-3">
    <section class="tile" aria-labelledby="h-rows">
      <h2 id="h-rows" class="tile-title">Rows read per sheet</h2>
      <table class="data-table compact">
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">Sheet</th><th scope="col" class="num">Rows</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rowsBySheet.map(([s, n]) => htl.html`<tr><th scope="row">${s}</th><td class="num">${n}</td></tr>`)}</tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
    <section class="tile" aria-labelledby="h-status">
      <h2 id="h-status" class="tile-title">Opportunities by status</h2>
      <table class="data-table compact">
        <thead><tr><th scope="col">verification_status</th><th scope="col" class="num">Rows</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${statuses.map(s => htl.html`<tr><th scope="row">${s}</th><td class="num">${data.statusCounts.get(s) ?? 0}</td></tr>`)}
          ${other.map(([s, n]) => htl.html`<tr><th scope="row">${s}</th><td class="num">${n}</td></tr>`)}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
    <section class="tile" aria-labelledby="h-shown">
      <h2 id="h-shown" class="tile-title">Shown on the site</h2>
      <table class="data-table compact">
        <tbody>
          <tr><th scope="row">Opportunities shown</th><td class="num">${opps.length}</td></tr>
          <tr><th scope="row">Verified / Unverified</th><td class="num">${shownVerified} / ${opps.length - shownVerified}</td></tr>
          <tr><th scope="row">Hidden by a failing check</th><td class="num">${data.hiddenCount}</td></tr>
          <tr><th scope="row">Organisations shown</th><td class="num">${data.orgs.length}</td></tr>
          <tr><th scope="row">Host cities / countries</th><td class="num">${data.places.length} / ${countries.length}</td></tr>
          <tr><th scope="row">Latest last_checked</th><td class="num">${data.snapshot ? fmtDate(data.snapshot) : "–"}</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>
  </div>`;
}
```

## Failing rows

```{ojs}
{
  const ps = data.problems;
  if (!ps.length) return htl.html`<p class="check-ok" role="status"><strong>No problems found.</strong> Every Verified and Unverified record passes all checks, and all ${opps.length} are shown.</p>`;
  return htl.html`<p class="check-fail" role="status"><strong>${plural(ps.length, "problem")} found</strong>; ${plural(data.hiddenCount, "record is", "records are")} hidden until fixed.</p>
  <div class="table-scroll"><table class="data-table">
    <caption>Rows that fail a data check</caption>
    <thead><tr><th scope="col">Sheet</th><th scope="col">ID</th><th scope="col">Field</th><th scope="col">Problem</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${ps.map(p => htl.html`<tr><td>${p.sheet}</td><th scope="row">${p.id}</th><td><code>${p.field}</code></td><td>${p.problem}</td></tr>`)}</tbody>
  </table></div>`;
}
```

## What is checked

Checks apply to Verified and Unverified records (and to the organisations and host cities they use) unless stated.

1. Required fields present: `opportunity_id`, `org_id`, `name`, `opportunity_type`, `discipline_area`, `funding_type`, `duration_max_weeks`, `host_city`, `source_url`, `verification_status`, `last_checked`. An Unverified record may leave `duration_max_weeks` blank when the duration is the detail still to confirm.
2. `org_id` exists in Organisations.
3. `host_city` exists in Places, with numeric latitude and longitude.
4. Values come from the allowed lists (organisation type, visa value, contact type, opportunity type, discipline, funding type, verification status on every row).
5. `duration_max_weeks` is 26 or less.
6. Verified records: `source_official` is Yes and `status_reasons` is empty.
7. Unverified records: `status_reasons` names the missing detail.
8. `opportunity_id` and `org_id` are unique across all rows.
9. URLs start with `http` (`contact_page` may also be a `mailto:` link).
